sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by a general tendency to hardening and contraction of the tissues. It is useful in cases of constipation and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of dryness and lack of secretions. It is also useful in cases of malignant diseases and tumors.
sections.Mind: Confused and forgetful. Depression and anxiety.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo.
sections.Throat: Dryness and rawness in the throat. Swollen and hard. Sensation of a splinter in the throat.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Thirst. Heaviness and pressure after eating.
sections.Abdomen: Distended and hard. Flatulence. Chronic constipation.
sections.Rectum: Stool large, hard, and dry. Much straining. Constipation. Haemorrhoids, with burning and itching.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of tearing in the larynx.
